title: CBIC tariff values for gold and silver (Customs Act, 1962, s.14(2))
howToUpdate: Add one entry per new Customs (N.T.) tariff-value notification. Copy the gold and silver numbers from the notification text exactly. Do not rely on the '(i.e., no change)' marker: notifications 72/2026 and 75/2026 print it next to silver although silver changed. Set lastReviewed to the date you checked that no newer notification exists.
coverageNote: Entries are continuous from 60/2026 (in force 1 Jul 2026): each notification's 'last amended vide' clause names the previous one. Dates before coverageFrom return UNAVAILABLE.
lastReviewedNote: No notification after 75/2026 was found during research on 25 Sep 2026.
cadence: Regular issues dated around the 15th and the last day of the month, in force the next day; ad hoc revisions on any day, also in force the next day.
